name: Neijiang

queries.query: Neijiang China official cadastral parcel map land registry GIS natural resources bureau
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the Sichuan government service catalog for Neijiang property-registration inquiries, a Sichuan government report on Neijiang land-acquisition information disclosure, the national Real Estate Registration Center directory, and a national map-service directory entry for the Neijiang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. No public anonymous Neijiang parcel feature endpoint was identified.

queries.query: 内江 不动产登记 地籍图 宗地图 自然资源和规划局 官方
queries.result: 中文 first-party discovery found the Sichuan government service record naming the Dongxing District Real Estate Registration Center as the implementing authority, the Sichuan government report describing Neijiang's municipal land-acquisition disclosure portal, and official national directories. These establish local registration custody and procedures but expose no anonymous parcel polygon API or safe parcel-ID-plus-geometry response.

officialSources.observation: Official Sichuan government service page identifies the Neijiang Dongxing District Real Estate Registration Center as the implementing authority for real-estate registration-record inquiry and describes required materials and inquiry procedures. It is not an open cadastral feature service.

Official Sichuan government report says Neijiang publishes municipal land-acquisition information through county/district government portals and a one-stop disclosure arrangement. This is public administrative information, not parcel geometry or title data.

Official Ministry of Natural Resources Real Estate Registration Center directory provides a national directory of local registration websites and registration information services; it does not expose a Neijiang anonymous parcel layer in the accessible page.

National official map-service directory entry names the Neijiang Natural Resources and Planning Bureau. The fetched store page did not expose a usable parcel service URL, schema, CRS or geometry response.

requests.outcome: Official service page loaded through public GET. It documented local registration inquiry custody/procedure but returned no anonymous parcel geometry, native parcel ID, schema or CRS.
Official map-directory page returned, but its accessible response contained no usable public parcel map/API configuration or feature response.
Official national registration-center directory was available and confirmed the national/local service context; no anonymous Neijiang parcel endpoint was exposed.
Official Sichuan report was available and described Neijiang land-acquisition disclosure. No parcel vector data or safe native parcel identity was returned.

registryBasis: A local registry custodian is evidenced by the official Sichuan government service page naming the Neijiang Dongxing District Real Estate Registration Center and describing the local registration-record inquiry service. This establishes institutional custody/procedure, not an open parcel geometry service.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Neijiang municipal/district registration and land-information services.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local institutional custody and public administrative disclosure procedures only; anonymous parcel geometry and citywide open coverage were not verified.
